interpretation: A source-free VueScan residual trained on three hardware models regresses every held fourth model relative to identity, despite remaining analytically bounded. Software is therefore not an independently transferable scanner-profile axis on this cohort; scanner nuisance must at least bind device and software together unless new crossed data prove otherwise.
next_leaf: Do not add capacity or tune this cohort. P6 random scanner-noise identification still requires fixed-condition repeats; future scanner profiles must bind device plus software and obtain independent measured-target validation.
claim_ceiling: Four-hardware same-target-set scaled ColorReference patch evidence for failure of one shared VueScan nuisance residual; not repeat-noise, scanner calibration, independent-target transfer, film-stock response, full-resolution output, redistribution, or product evidence.
